WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfl_store_weeks) AS lfl_sw, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1 FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY 1
),
s AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN rng r ON f.sale_date BETWEEN r.d0 AND r.d1
),
ret AS (
  SELECT r.fiscal_year, f.* FROM fact_return_line f JOIN rng r ON f.return_date BETWEEN r.d0 AND r.d1
)
SELECT 'sales' AS t, fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id || '-' || line_no) AS dist_rl, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads FROM s GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', fiscal_year, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ret GROUP BY 2

WITH nl AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.v) AS mine
    FROM nl n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE c.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_year) AS fy, COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) AS store_id, ROUND(m.mine,2) AS mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) AS ctl, ROUND(m.mine - c.ctl,2) AS diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year = c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id = c.store_id
WHERE m.mine IS NULL OR c.ctl IS NULL OR ABS(m.mine - c.ctl) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.region, st.format, st.open_date, st.close_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-05-31' AND c.closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-04-28' AND (c.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-05-31')) AS closures_nearby,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_sales),0) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id = st.store_id AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31') AS ty_ctl,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_sales),0) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id = st.store_id AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25') AS ly_ctl
FROM dim_store st
WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900 AND (st.open_date IS NOT NULL OR st.close_date IS NOT NULL OR st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure))
ORDER BY 1
